Facts:
- Son of a Gun is the debut EP single by the Glasgow alternative rock group The Vaselines.
- Incesticide is a compilation album by the American grunge band Nirvana.
- Before Incesticide was released, most of its material was already circulating among fan communities in lower quality.
- Because Incesticide compiled songs from different recording sessions, including sessions from periods when Nirvana lacked a stable lineup, the album features four drummers: Chad Channing, Dan Peters, Dale Crover, and Dave Grohl.
- In 1992, DGC re-released Nirvana's song "Sliver" to radio to support the release of the rarities compilation album Incesticide.
- The title song from The Vaselines' Son of a Gun EP reached a wider audience after Nirvana covered it, along with "Molly's Lips", on Incesticide.
